mapper.sql: SELECT h.hazard_id, h.hazard_code, h.risk_point_id, h.hazard_desc, h.hazard_type, h.hazard_level, h.photos, h.discover_person_id, h.discover_person, h.discover_time, h.source_type, h.task_id, h.dept_id, h.dept_name, h.person_id, h.person_name, h.rectify_req, h.rectify_deadline, h.hazard_status, h.rectify_desc, h.rectify_photos, h.rectify_time, h.verify_person_id, h.verify_person, h.verify_time, h.verify_result, h.verify_comment, h.approve_person_id, h.approve_person, h.approve_time, h.approve_result, h.approve_comment, h.enterprise_id, h.del_flag, h.create_by, h.create_time, h.update_by, h.update_time, h.remark FROM biz_safety_hazard h LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON h.dept_id = d.dept_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM biz_safety_hazard WHERE del_flag = '0' AND hazard_status = #{hazardStatus}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(discover_time, '%Y-%m') as month, COUNT(1) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN hazard_level = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as general, SUM(CASE WHEN hazard_level = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as major, SUM(CASE WHEN hazard_status = '6' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as closed FROM biz_safety_hazard WHERE del_flag = '0' AND discover_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(discover_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
SELECT hazard_type as hazardType, COUNT(1) as count FROM biz_safety_hazard WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY hazard_type
SELECT hazard_level as hazardLevel, COUNT(1) as count FROM biz_safety_hazard WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY hazard_level
SELECT source_type as sourceType, COUNT(1) as count FROM biz_safety_hazard WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY source_type
SELECT dept_name as deptName, COUNT(1) as count FROM biz_safety_hazard WHERE del_flag = '0' AND dept_name IS NOT NULL AND dept_name != '' GROUP BY dept_name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 5
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_safety_hazard ( hazard_code, risk_point_id, hazard_desc, hazard_type, hazard_level, photos, discover_person_id, discover_person, discover_time, source_type, task_id, dept_id, dept_name, person_id, person_name, rectify_req, rectify_deadline, hazard_status, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{hazardCode}, #{riskPointId}, #{hazardDesc}, #{hazardType}, #{hazardLevel}, #{photos}, #{discoverPersonId}, #{discoverPerson}, #{discoverTime}, #{sourceType}, #{taskId}, #{deptId}, #{deptName}, #{personId}, #{personName}, #{rectifyReq}, #{rectifyDeadline}, #{hazardStatus}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_safety_hazard SET hazard_status = #{hazardStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE hazard_id = #{hazardId}
mapper.delete: UPDATE biz_safety_hazard SET del_flag = '2' WHERE hazard_id = #{hazardId}
UPDATE biz_safety_hazard SET del_flag = '2' WHERE hazard_id IN #{hazardId}
